name: gate-all-dp
summary: Standby gate v3: with automatic input, standby is refused while a source is active on any DP-class connector (DP or USB-C), not only the current one; fixed input: the selected one; no answer from the front-end: refused. v3: in link-held standby with automatic input, a source that becomes active on the other DP-class connector wakes the monitor (as a key does)
status: v2 hardware-tested 2026-10-08: automatic input, both outputs off -> deep standby, no wake for minutes; after a key wake the dock held the DP link (DP: source active) -> link-held standby, deep standby as soon as the dock released the link. v3 (edge wake) untested

edits.asm: gate3 (image head zero area 0x201900): automatic input -> ask ports 0 and 1 (edge wake from link-held standby), else the current port
gq (image head zero area 0x201280): 0x60/0xB for one DP-class connector: 0 active, 1 none, 2 not DP-class, 3 no answer
